notes: Performance reports retain all alternating paired samples and independent 20% p50/rate gates; capacity-only reports explicitly evaluate no performance gate.

Relation tuples are schema, relation, heap bytes, index bytes, total bytes. Duplicate absolute gateway metric snapshots are omitted; per-run counter deltas and observed peaks remain.
Gateway gauge peaks are sampled lower bounds; cross-node position gaps have probe skew. Catch-up times include probes; spool high water is since gateway start.
Data are local PostgreSQL 18.6/DuckDB 2.0 fixtures, not cloud-service or sustainable-production guarantees.
